segments.he: מעלת קברי צדיקים, כי הם שוכני עפר שגם בחייהם נעשים שכנים לעפר כמארז״ל ועי״ז יש להם בחי׳ כח המושך שיש להעפר, היינו שיש להם כח להמשיך אצלם קדושת אלקותו ית/ ולהמשיך בל העולם אל קדושת עבודתו ית/ ומכ״ש עתה אחר ההסתלקות שהם שוכני עפר ממש, ואז במקום קבורת הצדיק שם העפר הוא בחי׳ עפר ארץ ישראל אדמת קודש בבחי׳ צדיקים ירשו ארץ כמבואר במקום אחר, וע״כ בנקל שם להתעורר באמת לעבודתו ית׳ ולהגביר הכח המושך דקדושה על הכח המכריח. (יו״ט הייה אות ב׳).
segments.en: The Tzaddikim toil all their days to draw down true Torah innovations in a way that can arouse the hearts of Yisrael to return to Hashem — for all true Torah innovations are holy vessels and holy tzimtzumim [contractions] in the aspect of tikun [rectification], so that we can receive the illumination of the light of the Infinite through them gradually and in measure. But the adversary provokes each time to ruin everything. Even so, the Tzaddikim complete their part — and whatever they cannot complete in their lifetimes, they complete through their death, for the Tzaddikim are greater in their death than in their lifetimes. For then they depart and ascend to where they ascend — which is the aspect of Moshe our teacher, peace be upon him, who gave us the Torah and toiled all his days to establish the keeping of Torah in Yisrael. And afterward he departed and was included in the aspect of re'uva d're'avin [the supreme Will of Wills] — where is the ultimate sweetening and rectification of all the tzimtzumim, such that the attribute of strict law has no hold there whatsoever. And from there, after their passing, the true Tzaddikim draw the illumination of the Infinite into the hearts of all Yisrael — in the aspect of the rectification of the tzimtzumim described above — so that through this His kingdom will be revealed to all eyes, which is the ultimate purpose of creation.
